def load():

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
for n in [1,2,3]:
    i,o=G[f'Demo pair {n} input'],G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    t2=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(i) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==2]
    t1=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(i) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==1]
    # collect output nonzero cells with values
    nz=[(r,c,v) for r,row in enumerate(o) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=0]
    ones=set(t1); twos=set(t2)
    # nearest output cell to 2: min manhattan distance among nz excluding cells equal to endpoints
    best=min(((abs(r-a)+abs(c-b),r,c) for r,c,v in nz if (r,c) not in ones|(twos)), key=lambda x:x[0])
    near2=(best[1],best[2],best[0])
    # collect into sorted chain
    cells=sorted(nz,key=lambda p:(p[0],p[1]))
    # group contiguous runs
    runs=[]; cur=[cells[0]]
    for p in cells[1:]:
        prev=cur[-1]
        if p[0]==prev[0] and abs(p[1]-prev[1])==1:
            cur.append(p)
        elif p[0]==prev[0]+1 and p[1]==prev[1]-1:
            cur.append(p)
        elif p[0]==prev[0]+1 and p[1]==prev[1]+1:
            cur.append(p)
        else:
            runs.append(cur); cur=[p]
    runs.append(cur)
    print(f'--- demo {n}: 2={t2}, 1={t1}')
    print('  path runs:', [(run[0],run[-1], len(run), run) for run in runs])
    print('  cell nearest to 2 (incl dist):', near2)
    print('  full nz:', nz)
